labels.name: UVB
labels.function: Shorter band (280-315 nm); causes sunburn and the delayed tan

labels.name: UVA
labels.function: Longer band (315-400 nm); drives photoaging and immediate darkening

labels.name: Window glass
labels.function: Stops the shorter UV band but lets the longer band through

labels.name: Epidermis
labels.function: Outer layer where sunburn injury and later peeling occur

labels.name: Keratinocyte
labels.function: Receives transferred pigment; makes beta-endorphin after UV

labels.name: Melanocyte
labels.function: Makes melanin in melanosomes; up-regulated 2-3 days after sun

labels.name: Dermis
labels.function: Collagen-rich layer whose loss causes wrinkles and atrophy

labels.name: Fibroblast
labels.function: Collagen factory destroyed by free radicals in photoaging

labels.name: Dermal blood vessel
labels.function: Loses its collagen cushion with age; bruises as solar purpura

labels.name: Actinic keratosis
labels.function: Rough precancerous lesion from UV-induced DNA mutations

labels.name: Favre-Racouchot syndrome
labels.function: Comedonal lesions over the zygomatic cheeks

labels.name: Poikiloderma of Civatte
labels.function: V-shaped red-brown pigment with the central neck spared

labels.name: Polymorphous light eruption
labels.function: Itchy minute papules each spring on skin covered all winter

labels.name: Solar purpura
labels.function: Bruises after trivial trauma once dermal support is lost

labels.name: Solar lentigines
labels.function: Flat brown macules from long-term sun exposure

labels.name: Porphyria cutanea tarda
labels.function: Fragile bullae and scars; elevated 24-hour urine porphyrins
